newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P confirms SocGen, Paribas ratings after deal.
newsitem.headline: S&P confirms SocGen, Paribas ratings after deal.

text.p: S&P-Adef said on Thursday it had confirmed the long and short-term credit ratings of Societe Generale and Paribas following Societe Generale's deal to buy Credit du Nord from Paribas.
Societe Generale's long-term debt is rated AA- while its short term debt is rated A-1+. Cie Financiere de Paribas's long term debt is rated A- while its short term debt is A-2.
Societe Generale announced earlier on Thursday plans to acquire Credit du Nord, a 100 percent unit of Paribas.

"Despite Cie Financiere de Paribas's efforts to restructure Credit du Nord, the bank has never achieved a satisfactory return on equity. The sale of Credit du Nord means Cie Financiere de Paribas can concentrate on its two core business lines -- wholesale banking and specialised financial services," the ratings agency said.
"This acquisition will allow Societe Generale to increase its market share in France, especially among entrepreneurs and small and midsize firms, Credit du Nord's speciality," it added.
"Thanks to its presence in comparable businesses, Societe Generale appears in a better position than Cie Financiere de Paribas to benefit from Credit du Nord's franchise."
